department: Department of Civil Engineering & Management (CEM), Faculty of Engineering Technology (ET)

deadline.value: Regular PhD positions are advertised on the university vacancies site, and the posting sets the deadline.
deadline.quote: You can apply for a regular PhD position at our vacancies website.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is stated for civil engineering.

supervisor.value: Applicants with their own funding need a professor to confirm as prospective promotor before the application goes ahead.
supervisor.quote: If a professor is interested in supervising your project, they must first confirm their willingness to act as your prospective promotor.

funding.value: The CEM page describes four years of training on the job but does not say that all or most PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a master's degree or an equivalent qualification.
entry_route.quote: Hold a MSc degree or an equivalent qualification from an officially recognised university or accredited academic institution.

notes: CEM runs a four-year PhD trajectory and a two-year EngD (checked 2026-10-26). The EngD is not saved. No department fee or English rule is stated, so the university rules apply.
